feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. This is the iteration 5 design, reproduced unchanged: kp 2.0, ki 0.3, kd 0.1, base_speed 1.0, search_right, sensor weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], sensors at x = -0.04, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.04 (y = 0.05), sensor_size 0.012. It is the best raced design at 75.779 (iteration 5), and iteration 10 reproduced that score exactly, so the design is confirmed. Every single-field change tested since then lost score: kp 1.6 gave 51.18 (iteration 6), sensor_size 0.016 gave 60.12 (iteration 7), kd 0.2 gave 69.03 (iteration 8), and base_speed 1.1 gave 51.33 (iteration 9). Every run ends with one line-loss event and max_error of about 0.062 to 0.067 m, above the 0.06 m limit, with low steering oscillation, so the failure is a slow drift to one edge, not weaving. The untested sensor span (H14) is the only lever left with any logic behind it, but it cannot be checked without racing, and this is the final iteration, so a revision would cost two runs and gain no evidence before the race. Approve so the best measured design is the one scored on the unseen track. Read the race as follows: if the development tracks give about 75.8 with progress near oval 0.29, s-bend 0.15 and slalom 0.11, the run is deterministic and the design is reproduced. If the score differs, record that the run is not deterministic.
requested_changes: No design change before this race: race the iteration 5 design unchanged, since the best measured result is 75.779 and two confirming runs agree.
Untested for reference only (H14): outer sensors at x = -0.05 and +0.05 with sensor_size 0.012. Do not adopt it unless a later race is available to test it, because it has no race evidence yet.
